calls.resolutionRule: Right if the AD-15 composite gate PASSES for this arm; Wrong if it FAILS; Unresolved until the gate evaluates. (Interim reviews may re-call on descriptive evidence; doing so journals THIS call as superseded, outcome Unresolved.)
